trello.name: Add queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Implement monitoring and alerting on worker queue depth to eliminate blind spot that caused 16 minutes of no visibility before customer-facing 500s at 14:19. Create warning alert at 1,000 jobs and page alert at 5,000 jobs for payment workers and extend same thresholds to entire worker fleet in one pass. This addresses finding number one from postmortem for Tuesday outage where queue depth spiked at 14:03 with no alerting in place, leading to 41 minutes degraded service and ~15 minutes checkout dead.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic and dead-letter handling
trello.desc: Modify payment_worker.py _process_with_retry function to prevent retry storm. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap number of retries, and ensure failed jobs are routed to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of being re-enqueued at front of main queue on fifth failure. Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses to cover the scenario. Owner has context on code and will add coverage for 503 simulation. This addresses root cause of retry storm that self-DDoSed the system when card processor returned 503s.

trello.name: Increase DB connection pool and separate worker/API pools
trello.desc: Mitigate coupling that amplified outage when workers exhausted DB connections. Increase DB connection pool from default 20 to 100 for immediate relief and split worker and API connection pools to prevent worker pile-up from impacting API. Both changes are in same config file and should be done together. Owner will implement both parts as one task.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook with Priya
trello.desc: Refresh payment incident runbook to remove references to old Kibana decommissioned in March, add new logging links, document queue drain procedure improvised on Tuesday, and verify escalation phone numbers are current. One number still routes to former employee who left last year. Priya is on call and offered to own update given fresh experience; Kofi to confirm assignment after meeting.

trello.name: Automate status page updates for checkout error rate
trello.desc: Automate status page to reduce manual delay. When checkout error rate alert fires, automatically flip status page to investigating with template message via status provider API. Manual update previously took until minute 30 of incident causing 50 support tickets. Start integration with checkout alert first, extensible to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Create controlled chaos test plan to exercise secondary payment processor failover which is configured but never tested. Plan should include staging test first, then production execution during low-traffic window with explicit rollback plan. Kofi leads drafting; plan to be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until review is complete. This addresses risk that incident would have been non-event if failover worked.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from 6.0 EOL to 7.2
trello.desc: Plan and schedule upgrade of Redis from 6.0 to 7.2. Redis 6.0 security fixes ended in June. Migration requires config rename and persistence defaults changes, so requires proper change window scheduled with infra calendar, not casual Friday deploy. Not directly related to outage but infra debt identified during postmortem.
